findings: Overall held-out mean absolute prediction error was 0.007928.
Predictions were close for 14x4, 28x4 and 49x2, with absolute mean errors 0.00426, 0.00398 and 0.00148.
7x2 was a strong residual: predicted MAE 0.07013 versus observed 0.09212.
The preregistered held-out ranking was not recovered because 7x2 was predicted as low-error but observed as the highest-error candidate.
interpretation: Breaking the Exp026 confounding materially improved absolute prediction for most held-out architectures, but term counts alone are insufficient. The 7x2 residual motivates a controlled error-localization experiment.
next_research_direction: Localize the 7x2 residual by comparing it with matched low-error architectures at stage 1, head-on-reference-input, and propagated-stage1-error levels.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
